sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: Automation engineer with **2 years of automation experience** building **automation frameworks** and **end-to-end testing** solutions. Integrated automated suites into **DevOps pipelines** (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for PR gating and nightly regression, cutting release verification time from 3 days → 1 day. Skilled in Playwright, Selenium BDD, Rest Assured, and Docker.
